title: Form creation and inspection host
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-cli --test cli form_ and cargo test -p pdfxi-cli --bin pdfxi form pass; pdfxi form create writes a one-page PDF whose fields reload through pdfxi-forms and pdfxi-core, form list reports them, and FORMS-002 moves to verified.
notes: Hosts FieldSpec builders and serialize_form_pdf behind a compact KIND:NAME:RECT[:OPTIONS] description, verifies the bytes through load_acroform and pdfxi-core before writing, and adds form list.
